newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Nikko Securities Australia appoints new economist.
newsitem.headline: Nikko Securities Australia appoints new economist.

text.p: Nikko Securities (Australia) Ltd has appointed Peter Horn to the new position of chief economist, the company said on Monday.
Horn was most recently chief economist at SBC Warburg Australian, and prior to that worked in the Commonwealth Treasury for 14 years.
Nikko said the chief economist position was created to enhance the Australian operation's research capabilities as well as the global research capabilities of the Nikko Research Centre.
Nikko Securities (Australia) is a licensed stockbroker and underwriter, and is part of the Nikko Securities Ltd group.
In a statement, the company said it ranked third amongst bookrunners of international bonds issued by Australian and New Zealand issuers in the first half of 1997.
